2026-2027 – 50th Anniversary Celebration Season Schedule

We are thrilled to announce our special 2026-2027 season, celebrating 50 years of creating music as Omaha’s Community Band!

All of our formal season concerts are in the UNO Strauss Performing Arts Center.  Each concert features a special commissioned work for band with a reception following the performance in the main lobby.

See the flyer for this season’s concerts.

Sunday, October 18, 2026 – 7:30PM – UNO Strauss Performing Arts Center
– performance of composition by former NWS director and local composer Larry MacTaggart
Sunday, December 6 – 3:00PM – UNO Strauss Performing Arts Center
– Premier of flute concerto by Erika Svanoe with guest flutist Christie Beard
– This is a joint concert with the UNO University Band
Saturday, February 27, 2027 – 7:30PM – UNO Strauss Performing Arts Center
– featuring our first NWS Middle School All Star Honor Band
– Premiering a new composition for Middle School Band by William Owens
Sunday, April 25, 2027 – 7:30PM – UNO Strauss Performing Arts Center
– Premier of new composition for advanced concert band by local composer and former NWS Associate Director Keith Michael Davis
Sunday, May 2, 2027 – 3:00 pm  – Lord of Love Lutheran Church, 10405 Fort Street
– NWS Small Ensembles concert
– Experience the variety of talent within our playing membership

Summer Concerts with the Nebraska Wind Symphony Swingtones
Sunday, June 6 2027 – 6PM – St. Robert Bellarmine Catholic Church, 11802 Pacific St
Friday, July 2, 2027 – 7PM – Stinson Park, Aksarben Village, 2285 S 67th St

There is no admission charged for any of this season’s NWS concerts.
Your generous donation helps us keep providing free concerts.

Check out the Support Us page for more ways you can provide financial support for your community band.
